notes: Completed repository-backed Library Source Inventory projection. PostgreSQL ignored contract is registered and compiled, but not run locally because NAKO_TEST_POSTGRES_URL is absent. Missing item behavior remains implemented via LEFT JOIN; direct contract construction is not possible through normal repository writes because media_sources.item_id has FK/cascade integrity.
